title: 16 Years of Gratitude and the Community Built Journey
excerpt: The day before Thanksgiving 2025, I'm thinking about miles.
aeo_summary: The day before Thanksgiving 2025, I'm thinking about miles. Not the 811.4 miles across 31 marathons. Not the thousands of miles traveled from Las Vegas to Mumbai to Munich to Boston. The miles that matter most are the ones I never ran alone.
content:
The day before Thanksgiving 2025, I'm thinking about miles. Not the 811.4 miles across 31 marathons. Not the thousands of miles traveled from Las Vegas to Mumbai to Munich to Boston. The miles that matter most are the ones I never ran alone.

In this issue

  • 2009: Community Called, I Answered. Magento invited me to become their first unpaid forum moderator.
  • 2010: Community Invested in Me. Magento funded my training. Bob Schwartz pushed me toward founding Wagento and launching my first extension, CartX.
  • 2011: Earned My Seat at the Table. My first Magento Imagine in Los Angeles came through service, not agency size or technical credentials.
  • 2012: Created Community Tradition. The first Big Dam Run (originally "Mage::Run").
  • 2013-2014: Going Global. Opened a Bolivia office; met Vijay and Sanjay, launching Wagento India.
  • 2015: Community Reunification. eBay brought community members together in Las Vegas.
  • 2016: Peak Community Leadership Begins. Wagento built the Magento App Store in eight weeks.
